content.text:
===== COMPREHENSIVE SERVICE VERIFICATION (port 3000, no Porkbun) =====

--- 1. Frontend (Dashboard) ---
  GET /  -> 200
<title>Dashboard | Green Ecolution</title>

--- 2. Backend API ---
  GET /api/health -> 200
  GET /api/ready  -> 200

--- 3. Keycloak (auth.localhost) ---
  GET / -> 302 (redirect to login)
  GET /health/ready -> 200
  GET openid-configuration -> 200

--- 4. pgAdmin (pgadmin.localhost) ---
  GET / -> 302 (login page)

--- 5. Valhalla (valhalla.localhost) ---
  GET /status -> 200

--- 6. Streamlet (streamlet.localhost) ---
  GET /health -> 200 (text/plain; charset=utf-8)

===== CONTAINER STATE =====
workspace-keycloak-1: Up 18 minutes (healthy)
workspace-streamlet-1: Up 18 minutes
workspace-valhalla-1: Up 18 minutes (healthy)
workspace-pgadmin-1: Up 18 minutes
workspace-db-1: Up 24 minutes (healthy)
workspace-reverse-proxy-1: Up 24 minutes

observation.command:
bash -c "
echo '===== COMPREHENSIVE SERVICE VERIFICATION (port 3000, no Porkbun) ====='
echo
echo '--- 1. Frontend (Dashboard) ---'
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '  GET /  -> %{http_code}\n' -m 15 -H 'Host: localhost' http://localhost:3000/
curl -s -m 15 -H 'Host: localhost' http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>'
echo
echo '--- 2. Backend API ---'
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '  GET /api/health -> %{http_code}\n' -m 10 -H 'Host: localhost' http://localhost:3000/api/health
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '  GET /api/ready  -> %{http_code}\n' -m 10 -H 'Host: localhost' http://localhost:3000/api/ready
echo
echo '--- 3. Keycloak (auth.localhost) ---'
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '  GET / -> %{http_code} (redirect to login)\n' -m 15 -H 'Host: auth.localhost' http://localhost:3000/
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '  GET /health/ready -> %{http_code}\n' -m 15 -H 'Host: auth.localhost' http://localhost:3000/health/ready
curl -s -m 15 -H 'Host: auth.localhost' http://localhost:3000/realms/green-ecolution/.well-known/openid-configuration -o /dev/null -w '  GET openid-configuration -> %{http_code}\n'
echo
echo '--- 4. pgAdmin (pgadmin.localhost) ---'
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '  GET / -> %{http_code} (login page)\n' -m 15 -H 'Host: pgadmin.localhost' http://localhost:3000/
echo
echo '--- 5. Valhalla (valhalla.localhost) ---'
curl -s -m 10 -H 'Host: valhalla.localhost' http://localhost:3000/status -o /dev/null -w '  GET /status -> %{http_code}\n'
echo
echo '--- 6. Streamlet (streamlet.localhost) ---'
curl -s -m 10 -H 'Host: streamlet.localhost' -w '  GET /health -> %{http_code} (%{content_type})\n' -o /dev/null http://localhost:3000/health
echo
echo '===== CONTAINER STATE ====='
docker ps --format '  {{.Names}}: {{.Status}}'
"
